visibility_rule: Each character-specific pickup is physically present from world load. Normal perception reveals it only through the associated character's layer; a knowledgeable player may detect and target it via collision, location address or deep scanning. A carried artifact remains a real Entity and may be transferable where mechanics allow. Never spawn it only when changing heroes.
